description: Election Commission - K. M. H. B. Medagama was selected as the member of Sri Jayawardhanapura Kotte Municipal Council - D. N. W. Dewa was selected as the member of the Uhana Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Sri Jayawardanapura Kotte Municipal Council and Uhana Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of selected members to fill vacancies caused by party membership cessation, which falls under election-related matters.
